_comment: The cells the benchmark intends to publish, per wave. results/ holds what was
published; assemble_cell.py and assemble_audit.py compare the two. A cell's
expected run count comes from `reps` here, not from the dispatch.
arms: skills_hash is the content hash that defines the arm. null means the hash
is not checked.
A wave is one environment, one set of skill snapshots, and the model panel the
gateway offers when the wave starts, run to completion. Results are published
per wave under results/wave<n>/ and never pooled across waves.
pins: run.json fields every run in the wave must carry with exactly this value.
measured: what every pod must have, as read from the kernel (env_record.py
`measured`, checked by wave_check.py before the agent and by assemble_cell.py);
a key ending in _min is a lower bound.
rules: how runs are classified (summarize.py DEFAULT_RULES; keys left out keep
the default).

structural-brain-extraction-stroke: Runs exist on the VM and none are published. Declare its models and arms

neurodesk-qwen3: this model id. It is not declared, so no cell includes it.

_comment: model_fingerprint every run of a model must record (model_probe.py). The run
stops before the agent if the probe differs, and assemble refuses a cell
with more than one. qwen3 changed serving engine and gateway id during the
wave; its cells run as NRP.qwen3 on the engine fingerprinted here.
Runs the cluster stopped before they could record anything, with no known
infrastructure fault, that cannot be re-run in the wave's environment. Each
counts in its cell as a failed run (verdict LOST, score 0; summarize.py,
assemble_cell.py); stratified_effect.py --runs also reports the analysis without
them. A run stopped by a known infrastructure fault is re-run instead.
Key: <task>__<model>__<arm>__r<n>, bare model id.

diffusion-brain-mask__NRP.qwen3__env-onl.evidence: Both attempts (runner pods swt7d, 6nbsb) were evicted by the kubelet for node DiskPressure; on attempt 2 it was the only runner pod on its node and node root free fell to 4.38 GiB. Memory 6.4 and 1.67 of 16 GiB, work volume 6.2 and 2.65 of 40 GiB, no OOM kill. Kubelet journal: both pods were evicted to reclaim ephemeral storage and ranked first for eviction, which the kubelet does for a pod over its ephemeral-storage request (2 GiB), so the run's own writes outside the work volume exceeded 2 GiB; before the second eviction the node's image filesystem was already at 85%. The share of the node disk taken by the run versus shared node storage was not measured.

structural-brain-extraction._comment: Models are added when this task is scheduled.

_comment: From the gateway probe of 2026-10-05. EGI.kimi-k3 serves the same model as
wave 1's kimi-k3; NRP.minimax-m2 the same weights as wave 1's minimax-m2 on a
newer serving engine; NRP.qwen3 is unchanged; EGI.glm-5.3 is new.
Stated before the first dispatch. A run stopped by the cluster for what it
did (evicted, OOM-killed) with no record is declared in `lost` and counts as
a failed run (lost=fail); a run stopped by an infrastructure fault not of its
making (gateway outage, node failure, harness error) is re-run. A run at the
90-minute wall is a failed run (timeout=fail).
